Extending breakout to 200 days reduces whipsaw, while equal-risk weighting further stabilizes exposure across the concentrated BTC sleeve.
A slower dual100_200 crossover with 3-confirm and small hysteresis should cut false regime flips and boost Calmar versus dual50_200.
Combining trend and momentum with monthly cadence and only top-2 equal-risk positions should reduce turnover while preserving the strong validation fold.
